meta_description: EJC Electrical Ltd is a trusted electrician in Liverpool. Domestic and commercial electrical work, rewires, inspections, and emergency callouts. Call 07941 745440.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault at home or work in Liverpool? We arrive quickly, diagnose the problem, and fix it right first time.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs to full rewires, we handle all domestic and commercial electrical work to Building Regulations standards.

services.title: Emergency Callouts
services.desc: Power cuts, blown circuits, or faulty wiring? We respond within the hour, any day of the week. Rapid diagnosis and same-day fixes wherever possible.

services.title: Rewires & Upgrades
services.desc: Ageing wiring causes fires and faults. We carry out full rewires to modern standards, upgrade consumer units, and install new circuits to suit your needs.

services.title: Fault Finding & Testing
services.desc: Intermittent trips, burning smells, or flickering lights? We locate hidden faults quickly using specialist test equipment and put right what others miss.

services.title: Pat Testing & Inspections
services.desc: Landlord certification, workplace compliance, or peace of mind at home. We carry out portable appliance tests and full electrical safety inspections to current standards.

services.title: New Installations
services.desc: Kitchens, bathrooms, outdoor sockets, or EV charging points. We design and install new circuits safely, meeting all Building Regulations and Part P requirements.

services.title: Commercial & Industrial
services.desc: Office rewires, workshop upgrades, and factory maintenance. We work to tight schedules and minimise downtime for busy businesses across the Merseyside area.

about_pullquote: I started EJC because I got tired of seeing customers ripped off by cowboys and cowboys.
about_para_1: EJC Electrical was founded 15 years ago by Jamie Clark, a qualified electrician who believed Liverpool needed a trustworthy, no-nonsense electrical service. Since then, we've completed over 1,000 jobs across domestic and commercial properties, earning a reputation for turning up on time, doing the job properly, and charging fair prices.
about_para_2: We're NICEIC registered and work to current Building Regulations. Whether it's a midnight power cut or a planned kitchen rewire, our customers come back to us because we listen, explain what's needed, and get it done without fuss or surprise bills.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Customers Say About EJC Electrical

reviews.text: Had an absolute nightmare with sparking sockets before Christmas. Jamie came out the same day, found a dodgy junction box in the wall, and replaced it safely. Fair price and genuine expertise. Will use again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Called at 10pm on a Saturday because all the upstairs lights had gone. Not only did they answer, but Jamie was here in 45 minutes. Reset a breaker and checked the whole circuit. Brilliant service, very reasonable.
reviews.author: Michelle T.

reviews.text: Rewired our 1970s terrace from top to bottom. Took 4 days, professional throughout, left the house clean, and explained everything. No hidden charges. Highly recommend to anyone in Liverpool needing proper electrical work.
reviews.author: Robert H.
